newsitem.title: USA: Hilton has 710,000 ITT shares, extends bid.
newsitem.headline: Hilton has 710,000 ITT shares, extends bid.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp Friday said it had received about 710,000 ITT Corp shares to date in response to its $6.5 billion tender offer, and the offer's expiration has been extended until March 28.
ITT, which has rejected Hilton's cash and stock offer, has about 122.7 million shares outstanding.

Hilton said the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act expired at midnight Thursday, satisfying one condition of Hilton's cash tender offer for 50.1 percent of the shares of ITT at $55 per share.
The offer, which originally had an expiration date of Feb. 28, is now scheduled to expire at midnight EST Friday March 28/Saturday 0500 GMT, unless again extended.
Hilton said its offer of $55 per share represents a premium of 29 percent over the closing price for ITT's stock on Jan. 27, the day Hilton announced its bid to acquire ITT.

Following completion of the tender offer, Hilton intends to complete a merger in which all remaining ITT shares would be exchanged for Hilton stock at $55 per ITT share, subject to appropriate collar provisions.
